lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A notable vertical column of three spots is situated immediately posterior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like spatial arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature running longitudinally along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from light pixels on the dorsal side to shadowed pixels below.
